primary_claim: Under progressively stronger format controls that make five reasoning modes produce visually identical prose, features extracted from Llama 3.2 3B's attention-routing and KV-cache dynamics (but not logit statistics or residual-stream PCA) discriminate the model's internal processing mode at 78% accuracy (topic-heldout) while semantic text embeddings of the same outputs carry ~zero mode information, and prompt-swap controls show the signal tracks executed computation rather than instructed mode.

effect.metric: topic-heldout discrimination accuracy of processing mode from computational-signature features vs semantic embeddings/TF-IDF
effect.value: computational features 78% (positive silhouette) vs semantic embeddings (all-MiniLM-L6-v2) 48% (negative silhouette) vs TF-IDF 14% (86% train-test gap); text-to-compute regression median R^2 = -1.11 (363/366 features anti-predicted); prompt-swap texts computationally indistinguishable from pure linear at 50% (chance)

stated_future_work: 8B replication with more samples to check for the same regime structure and finer within-regime discrimination
Naturalistic (non-scaffolded) generation experiments to test higher effective dimensionality and orthogonality predictions in the wild
Further geometric characterization of the computational-signature space across resolutions
Replications on more model families to map architecture/training differences
Deeper feature engineering to localize which model sections carry which signal
A subliminal-learning follow-up comparing teacher/student model signature deltas against reported subliminal-transfer effects
limitations_stated: All experiments conducted on a single model (Llama 3.2 3B) at small sample sizes
Feature engineering will likely need to shift model-to-model and especially across architecture families (e.g. dense GQA vs MoE)

Orthogonality is a property of the mode-relevant subspace after contrastive projection, not the full feature space (raw Mantel correlation r=0.40, meaning topic explains more variance than mode at that level)

Falsification criteria for cross-architecture replication (e.g. 8B model) are hard to specify in advance since a negative result could mean the signal isn't there or that the instrument needs recalibration
quote: Under format control, where five processing modes produce visually identical paragraph prose, attention routing and KV cache features discriminate processing mode at 78% accuracy (topic-heldout, p < 0.001), while semantic embeddings of the same texts carry effectively zero mode information.
